comment: VERBATIM copy of the fleet-standard cam-90-deg.json (gamma-fleet intrinsics; confirmed byte-identical to /Volumes/data/.../intrinsics/cam-90-deg.json, 2026-07-03). This is the exact file lsd applied to ALL training data - do NOT replace it with a per-camera/physically-refined calibration (e.g. the raw libCalib report cam-90-deg/calib-pinhole.json, which has meaningfully different k1..k4): the model learned the residual distortion of THIS fit, so parity with training beats physical accuracy. Only change together with the training pipeline.
